request.prompt:
Goods: Stainless steel cutlery set, 24 pieces
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 82 Tools, implements, cutlery, spoons and forks, of base metal; parts thereof, of base metal

Choose the heading that covers these goods. Options:
- 8215: Cutlery; spoons, forks, ladles, skimmers, cake-servers, fish-knives, butter knives, sugar tongs and similar kitchen or tableware
    contains 821520: Cutlery; sets of assorted articles (e.g. spoons, forks, ladles, skimmers, cake-servers, fish-knives, butter knives, sugar tongs and similar), not plated with precious metal
    contains 821510: Cutlery; sets of assorted articles (e.g. spoons, forks, ladles, skimmers, cake-servers, fish-knives, butter-knives, sugar tongs and similar), with at least one article plated with precious metal
    contains 821599: Cutlery; other than plated with precious metal
    contains 821591: Cutlery; (e.g. spoons, forks, ladles, skimmers, cake-servers, fish-knives, butter-knives, sugar tongs and similar), plated with precious metal, not in sets
- 8208: Knives and cutting blades, for machines or for mechanical appliances
    contains 820830: Tools; knives and cutting blades, for kitchen appliances or for machines used by the food industry
- 8211: Knives; with cutting blades, serrated or not (including pruning knives), other than knives of heading no. 8208, and blades therefore
    contains 821110: Knives; with cutting blades, serrated or not (including pruning knives), sets of assorted articles, excluding knives and blades of heading no. 8208
- 8209: Tools; plates, sticks, tips and the like for tools, unmounted, of sintered metal carbides or cermets
    contains 820900: Tools; plates, sticks, tips and the like for tools, unmounted, of sintered metal carbides or cermets
- 8206: Tools, hand; two or more of heading no. 8202 to 8205, put up in sets for retail sale
    contains 820600: Tools, hand; two or more of heading no. 8202 to 8205, put up in sets for retail sale
- 8214: Cutlery; other articles, (e.g. hair clippers, butchers' or kitchen cleavers, choppers and mincing knives, paper knives), manicure or pedicure sets and instruments (including nail files)
    contains 821410: Cutlery; paper knives, letter openers, erasing knives, pencil sharpeners and blades therefore

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: A 24-piece stainless steel cutlery set of spoons, forks and knives is tableware cutlery covered by heading 8215, in the subheading for sets not plated with precious metal (821520).
